# normfix

normfix safely formats 42 School C projects and explains edits it cannot prove.

- AI-agent guide: https://normfix.vercel.app/docs/guide/ai-agents
- Commands: https://normfix.vercel.app/docs/commands/
- JSON report schema: https://normfix.vercel.app/docs/reference/reporting
- Safety and recovery: https://normfix.vercel.app/docs/reference/safety
- Official repository: https://github.com/viniciusnevescosta/normfix
- Official Norminette: https://github.com/42school/norminette

Read-only project check for an agent:

    normfix check --format json

Do not run formatting or unsafe flags without explicit permission to write.
